s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent pleural effusion with lymphocytic predominance in a patient with a history of empiric treatment for presumed extrapulmonary tuberculosis
salient_findings: Negative cultures and stains for infectious organisms
key_facts: 84-year-old Asian man
Admitted with dyspnea
Started empiric RIPE nine months earlier for presumed extrapulmonary tuberculosis
Initial colonoscopic biopsy showed granulomas with acid-fast stain–positive organism
Subsequent biopsies and sputum cultures were negative
QuantiFERON-TB Gold testing was negative
Developed dyspnea, cough, and weakness four weeks after starting RIPE
Thoracentesis yielded exudative, lymphocyte-predominant fluid with red color
Pleural fluid showed lymphocytosis (96%) and low complement activity
Multiple pleural biopsies showed inflammation without granulomata
Serum testing revealed an ANA titer of 1:160 with a speckled pattern

Thoracentesis yielded exudative, lymphocyte-predominant fluid with red color

differentials: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis
per_call: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis

shortlist.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Positive ANA titer and speckled pattern, consistent with autoimmune disease

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Lymphocytic predominance in pleural fluid and granulomas on initial colonoscopic biopsy

shortlist.label: Tuberculous pleurisy
shortlist.why_kept: History of empiric treatment for presumed extrapulmonary tuberculosis and initial acid-fast stain-positive organism

shortlist.label: Drug-induced lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Patient on RIPE therapy, which can cause drug-induced lupus, and positive ANA titer

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Exudative lymphocyte-predominant pleural effusion, which can be seen in lymphoma

raw.rationale: The patient developed symptoms consistent with lupus, such as pleural effusion and positive ANA titer, after starting RIPE, which includes isoniazid, a known cause of drug-induced lupus.

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and positive ANA titer appeared after starting RIPE, suggesting a drug-induced rather than idiopathic cause.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: The patient's pleural biopsies showed inflammation without granulomata, which is not typical of sarcoidosis.

rejected.label: Tuberculous pleurisy
rejected.why: The patient's cultures and QuantiFERON-TB Gold testing were negative, making tuberculous pleurisy less likely.

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's cytology and biopsies did not show evidence of lymphoma, and the pleural fluid findings were more consistent with an inflammatory process.
